title: Random Reforges
description: Applies random reforges to your gear - works with all modded items and attributes.
body:
Inspired by: Cursed1nferno's Modifiers (I recommend it if you dont want to use reforges that use non-vanilla attributes and/or if you are too lazy to make new reforges.)

Feel free to join:  [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/DDgKjEcb8N)

 

This mod adds reforges that give buffs and/or debuffs to the following (modded) items/item groups:

- Swords/Tridents
- Armor
- Tools
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks' Spellbooks (if installed)
- Curios (if installed)
- Bows
- Shields
- EVERY (modded) item (using item id/item tags)

 

Features:

- Full mod compatibility
- No dependencies - Keep your modpack clean (You can't use attributes from mods that are not installed)
- Highly customizable reforges with an easy to understand GUI (check the gallery, v1.4 and newer)
- Ingame explanation for the GUI (check the gallery, v1.4 and newer)
- Pretty big default reforge list
  - ~80 reforges
  - includes reforges for spellbooks from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbook
  - includes reforges for all items in curio slots
  - togglable in the GUI
- supports item id, item tags and already defined groups as reforge targets
- command to reforge items (/reforge <playername> apply <reforge-id>)
- command to permanently make an item unreforgable (/reforge <playername> clear)
- JEI support

 

 

HOW TO REROLL REFORGES!
1. Craft an empty "Soulless Reforge Core"
2. Use it on any villager to catch its soul (Soulless villagers cant exist, so it will despawn.) and youll get a "Reforge Core".
3. Craft an "Empty Reforge Cage".
4. Rightclick it with the Reforge Core to put the Core in it and turn it into a "Reforge Cage".
5.Rightclick while having at least 5 experience levels and holding the item you want to reforge -> This will reroll the reforge.
_Note: Items that got their reforge cleared with /reforge <target> clear cant get a new reforge in survival._

 

This mod is compatible with Apotheosis' Adventure Module, but the item names are a bit messed up (Cursive prefix + non-cursive reforge name + cursive item name).
